metadata.title: Pricing - Klarpakke University
metadata.description: Plans: Student (free), Bachelor, Master, PhD, or Professor. All paid plans include Norwegian tax export. Pay with Stripe.

klt.title: What is KLT?
klt.body: KLT is Klarpakke’s in-app reward points. You earn them by completing lessons and can use them for competitions and the leaderboard — including the monthly 50,000 KLT prize. KLT is not cryptocurrency, cannot be bought or sold outside Klarpakke, and has no cash value.

faqKlt.a: No. KLT are points inside Klarpakke that reward learning and activity. They’re used for games, competitions, and future in-platform perks — not as money outside the app.

cancel.title: Payment Canceled
cancel.subtitle: You canceled the payment. No worries - you can try again anytime!
cancel.whyFailedA: There might be temporary issues with your bank or card. Try again or use another card.
cancel.chargedA: No, you are only charged when payment is completed. No hidden fees.
cancel.trialQ: Can I try for free first?
cancel.trialA: Master, PhD, and Professor include a 14-day free trial. Bachelor starts without a trial. You can cancel anytime.
